cases.customer_question: Can the antenna datasheet required for Bluetooth qualification be taken directly from the BLE module specification?
question_variants: Is the module datasheet acceptable as antenna evidence?
What antenna document is required for compliance folder submission?
Can we reuse the BLE module antenna specification pages?
Do we need a separate antenna report?
What antenna information must be submitted?
cases.actual_issue: Bluetooth qualification compliance documentation requires antenna information including radiation gain characteristics, and existing module documentation may be acceptable if it contains the required information.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The customer wanted to know whether they could submit pages from the BLE module specification instead of creating a separate antenna document. The consultant confirmed this was acceptable as long as the documentation included antenna radiation gain characteristics. This reduced the need for additional custom documentation.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant confirmed that the antenna datasheet requirement could be satisfied using the relevant section of the BLE module specification document, provided that the submitted pages included radiation gain characteristic information.
cases.decision_logic: The qualification documentation requirement is based on the presence of required antenna technical information, not the document source itself. Existing module specifications are acceptable if they contain the necessary RF characteristic data.
cases.final_recommendation: Submit the relevant BLE module specification pages as the antenna datasheet evidence if they include antenna radiation gain characteristics and related RF details.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Incomplete antenna evidence may delay compliance folder completion or trigger requests for additional technical documentation.
